# Test the improved evaluate_plans_memoized with caching
env = PointEnv(length=200, goal_x=2, goal_y=0, goal_radius=1)

# Test plans with shared prefixes
plans = np.array([
    [1, 1, 1, 1],    # All right moves
    [1, 1, 1, 3],    # Right, right, right, up  
    [1, 1, 3, 1],    # Right, right, up, right
    [1, 3, 1, 1],    # Right, up, right, right
])

print("Testing improved caching with shared prefixes:")
print("Plans:")
for i, plan in enumerate(plans):
    print(f"  Plan {i}: {plan}")

# Evaluate plans
rewards = env.evaluate_plans_memoized(plans)
print(f"\nRewards: {rewards}")

# Check cache contents
print(f"\nCache size: {len(env._cache)}")
print("Sample cache entries:")
for key, (pos, reward) in list(env._cache.items())[:5]:
    print(f"  {key}: position={pos}, cumulative_reward={reward}")
